title: StrictLocalMateProjectionData
statement: For f:X→S, a geometric point s, K in D⁺(Ab(X_et)), integer n and canonical geometry Q [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry], define the section homology map of the derived base-change mate and its exact-sections Leray target isomorphism. StrictLocalMateProjectionData gives stage identifications from derived sections of Rf_*K [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs] to neighbourhood hypercohomology, compatible with transition pullbacks, and identifies each canonical source leg followed by the mate with projection pullback followed by the inverse target isomorphism. It does not include a source or target colimit assertion.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure-sheaf stalks and ordinary module pullback; none realizes these abelian derived-section maps. Loogle presheafToSheaf, homology and IsPullback, IsAffineHom queries returned no hits.

Mathlib has general stalk and pullback infrastructure, but no strict-local derived mate or the canonical derived Hom-to-germ comparison. The existing AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf has private definitions of the comparison, inaccessible from another module.
